title: Reports GraphQL accepts any signed JWT without session or RBAC checks
why: decode_token only verifies JWT signature/claims. It does not look up sid in Mongo sessions, check revocation, or enforce admin/LOG:READ/USER:READ. Any logged-in user who obtains a bearer token (including via /admin/reports with no client isAdmin gate) can query platform-wide overview, action-log aggregates, user activity, and survey analytics. Logout on the main API does not invalidate reports access until JWT expiry.
fix: Validate sessions the same way as Express protect (session id + token hash + not revoked), then authorize with RBAC. Fail closed when require_auth is true. Gate the admin reports page on isAdmin.

title: Survey response listing is effectively an IDOR under allowAnyInstance
why: The route authorizes SURVEY_RESPONSE:READ with allowAnyInstance:true and then loads all responses for the survey id without filtering to granted resourceIds or requiring SURVEY:READ on that survey.
fix: Require instance-scoped or class-wide access for returned responses; ideally also require SURVEY:READ on :id. Use attachAccessible and filter SurveyResponse by accessible ids.

title: Password-reset flow enumerates users and stores usable tokens insecurely
why: Unknown emails return 404 while known emails succeed. Endpoint is GET with email in query string. Tokens are stored plaintext, last three days, and are returned in JSON when NODE_ENV !== production. No rate limit.
fix: Always return generic 200; switch to POST; store token hash; shorten TTL; never return token in API responses; rate-limit; use a real mailer abstraction.

title: Session bearer tokens live in localStorage
why: Any XSS can steal authToken and call /api/* and reports GraphQL as the victim until revoke or JWT expiry.
fix: Prefer httpOnly Secure SameSite cookies from the API/BFF; stop persisting JWTs in localStorage.

title: Mass assignment on user and group updates
why: updateUser spreads req.body after only deleting password/reset fields so callers can set roleId and isVerified. updateGroup passes entire req.body, allowing direct overwrite of members.
fix: Whitelist fields. Keep membership and role changes on dedicated endpoints with explicit checks and action logs.

title: No rate limiting or baseline HTTP security middleware on the API
why: Login, register, and forgot-password are unauthenticated and unlimited. express.json has no size limit; no Helmet.
fix: Add helmet, JSON body limit, and stricter express-rate-limit on /api/auth/*.

title: Controllers leak internal exception messages to clients
why: Responses include error: error.message which can expose Mongo/driver internals.
fix: Centralize error handling: log server-side; return stable message + code only.

title: Client access cache can retain elevated grants for five minutes
why: UI authorization is cached in sessionStorage for 5 minutes. After permission removal the UI may still show admin affordances.
fix: Shorten TTL, invalidate on focus, force refresh on admin routes. Never treat client can as security.

title: Registration and admin user creation skip password policy
why: changeOwnPassword requires length >= 8 but register/create/reset accept any non-empty password.
fix: Share one password validator across register, create, reset, and change flows.

title: isVerified is never enforced at login
why: Field is seeded/displayed but login does not require verification.
fix: Enforce isVerified or remove the field until email verification exists.

title: Asset POST briefly skips authorization for survey kinds
why: SURVEY/SURVEY_RESPONSE call next() without CREATE check; createAsset then returns 400. Defense-in-depth hazard if controller changes.
fix: Reject survey kinds in the route middleware with 400 before next(), or always authorize CREATE.

title: Add rate limiting and security headers at the Express edge
why: Auth and mutation endpoints lack brute-force protection and common security headers.
fix: Mount helmet, JSON body size limit, and stricter rate limits on auth routes.

title: Align reports auth with Express session validation
why: Reports and main API share JWT_SECRET but not session semantics; logout is not global.
fix: Have reports validate sessions (or call /api/auth/validate) and apply RBAC for report fields.

title: Scope survey-response APIs the same way as survey lists
why: Survey listing uses attachAccessible; response listing does not — inconsistent and over-broad.
fix: Reuse listAccessibleResources/attachAccessible for SURVEY_RESPONSE and add regression tests.

title: Throttle touchSession writes on every authenticated request
why: Each protected request saves lastSeenAt, amplifying Mongo write load under polling UIs.
fix: Update lastSeenAt only if older than N seconds, or use a time-predicate updateOne.

title: Introduce a shared password policy helper
why: Password rules differ by endpoint.
fix: One assertPasswordPolicy used by register/create/reset/change; document in OpenAPI.

title: Prefer cookie-based session delivery for the browser app
why: Bearer-in-localStorage maximizes XSS impact and duplicates auth header logic.
fix: Set httpOnly session cookie on login; use credentials include for same-origin /api.

title: Centralize API error responses
why: Hand-rolled 500 responses with error.message are duplicated and leak internals.
fix: Use sendError helper / Express error middleware with stable codes.

title: Add client-side admin route guards (defense in depth)
why: Nav hides admin links but pages like admin/reports load for any authenticated visitor who knows the URL.
fix: Shared AdminGate redirecting non-admins after ensure(), with server auth as real control.

title: Extract shared list-query parsing
why: Page/limit/sort parsing is copy-pasted with slight differences.
fix: Small parsePaginationQuery utility for surveys, logs, and future lists.

title: Close the dead auth path on asset create
why: Survey kinds skip CREATE checks then fail in the controller — easy to misread.
fix: Return 400 in the route for survey kinds (or always authorize).

title: rbacService.js mixes ACL core with presentation/catalog concerns
why: ~670 lines mix permission evaluation with survey-response label builders, catalog DTOs, and index migration.
fix: Split into rbacEvaluate, rbacAclWrite, rbacCatalog, permissionMigrate modules.

title: PermissionModal.tsx is a monolith UI + data layer
why: ~700 lines combine catalog loading, ACL fetch, principal selection, scopes, and Apply payload.
fix: Extract hooks and presentational subcomponents.

title: Identity authorize(USER:…) signatures are misleading
why: Routes look instance-scoped but identity permissions only check admin-group membership.
fix: Introduce requireAdminGroup() middleware; stop using asset-style param options for identity routes.

title: Asset create middleware has a confusing authorize-by-falling-through path
why: SURVEY kinds call next() without permission check, relying on a later 400.
fix: Early return 400 for survey kinds so the happy path is check CREATE → createAsset.

title: Client and server duplicate RBAC evaluation rules
why: isClassWide, allowAnyInstance, classWideOnly, and WRITE⇒CREATE are duplicated and can drift.
fix: Share a small pure module for parsing/evaluation; keep Mongo loading server-only.

title: Duplicated requestMeta helpers
why: Same IP/UA/x-client-app extraction in two places invites inconsistency.
fix: One api/utils/requestMeta.js imported by auth and action-log middleware.

title: Inconsistent API error JSON shapes
why: Mix of {message,code}, {message,error}, hint/username makes client parsing fragile.
fix: Standardize on {message, code, details?} and update apiUtils once.

title: roleId naming vs group membership model
why: roleId refs Group while users also appear in Group.members; comments still say role group.
fix: Rename to primaryGroupId or document clearly; align UI copy with groups.

title: Large inline GraphQL document in the client helper
why: Long query string dominates the module and hides transport logic.
fix: Move operations to client/lib/reports/queries.ts; keep helper focused on transport.

title: Leftover structural comments in models
why: Numbered section headers imply a multi-model file that no longer exists.
fix: Remove obsolete banners; keep only comments for non-obvious invariants.

title: Two overlapping permission-write APIs
why: Group replaceClassPermissions and asset ACL apply both mutate Permission with different delete scopes; group endpoint can wipe instance grants.
fix: Pick one write model as canonical; deprecate/narrow the other; document delete semantics in OpenAPI.

title: Legacy principal queries remain on every authorization hot path
why: Every permission load still $ors legacy groupId rows without principalType.
fix: Finish migration/backfill, then remove legacy clauses and deprecated groupId.

title: Deleting groups does not clean related permissions
why: findByIdAndDelete removes only the group; orphaned GROUP permissions and user.roleId refs remain.
fix: Transactional delete of permissions, roleId cleanup, then group; add integration test.

title: Missing automated coverage for high-risk authz paths
why: No tests for cross-survey response IDOR under instance grants, mass assignment, or reports GraphQL session/RBAC.
fix: Add Jest cases for response scoping and update whitelists; add reports auth tests.

title: isVerified is dead weight in the domain model
why: Displayed and returned from /auth/me but never enforced.
fix: Implement verification end-to-end or remove field from schema/API/UI together.

title: No shared request-validation layer
why: Ad-hoc validation drifts from OpenAPI (password length, ACL payloads, pagination caps).
fix: Introduce Zod/Joi schemas per route family; optionally validate against OpenAPI in CI.

title: Password reset depends on a mock email logger
why: console.log email path; tests encode returning resetToken in non-production responses.
fix: Mailer interface with console adapter for dev; stop returning tokens in HTTP; update tests.

title: Example config encourages week-long JWTs
why: JWT_EXPIRE=7d widens stolen-token window especially with reports JWT-only auth.
fix: Default examples to short access lifetime; document revoke behavior.

title: Reports service sits outside the main Jest verification loop
why: FastAPI auth/schema regressions will not fail npm test.
fix: Add pytest script and wire into CI / verify-app skill.

title: Access-cache fingerprint embeds token fragments
why: Storing token substrings in sessionStorage increases residual secret material.
fix: Fingerprint sessionId or a hash of the token, not raw substrings.
